## Owner decisions, 2026-11-14

- AUTH-22 (R7-E1-001, R7-F1-001, R6-E2-001): branches of foreign banks are registered in Ukraine as Ukrainian entities, so «банки України» and the `banks` code cover them. No caveat needed.
- AUTH-23 (R7-F1-003, НБУ 178 п. 44): a bank must cover both п. 44 areas (security of cyber-protection objects; ISMS conformity with ISO/IEC 27001); it may do so in one audit or in two separate audits by area. Recorded as an assumption on el-017 A.5.35 and GV.OV-03 (the ISMS is mandatory under НБУ 95, and п. 45(1) requires penetration testing either way).
- AUTH-24 (R7-E2-001): НБУ 64 п. 290-51 is read literally — it applies to every contract with a cloud TPSP, without НБУ 99's limit to core business processes. Grounds stay "text".
- AUTH-25 (R7-E2-009, sources): always cite the primary source — the zakon.rada.gov.ua print or the issuing body's own site (bank.gov.ua for NBU acts, the SSSCIP site for its orders). iplex, docs.dtkt.ua and similar mirrors are not cited as the basis of a check. A secondary citation is replaced only after the row is checked against a primary text; where no primary text is available, the row keeps a dated [ПЕРЕВІРИТИ] marker naming the act.
- AUTH-26 (НБУ 178 text): the owner supplied the zakon.rada print of НБУ 178, ред. 19.06.2026 (texts/r8/nbu178.clean.txt). It is now the authoritative current text; checked_edition updated.
- AUTH-27 (R7-A1-009): the question was mislabelled «ст. 9»; it concerns Закон 80/94 ст. 8 ч. 11 п. 1. Re-asked; open.

- AUTH-27 answered (2026-11-14): no — Закон 80/94 ст. 8 ч. 11 п. 1 does not bind a КІІ owner whose systems hold no state information resources. a8-p11: tag «kii+!banks» removed (now state-ir+!banks;public-sector+!banks), marker replaced by a dated assumption.
